L2.title: Unconditional db.close() in finally can mask the in-flight exception
L2.resolution: Unconditional db.close() masking is inherent to the proven adhoc-20260712-955c958 idiom used across all 8 sites; wrapping db.close in try/except for a theoretical low-likelihood close-time error would break idiom consistency. Accept-as-is per the finding's own note.
